page.layout: One column of running text, full width. Printed page number 54 at the top left. Running head "CONCIONES" at the top centre. No marginal notes. Catchword "Deni-" at the bottom right, below the last full line.

main_text.p: (quanquam homicidium per se grauius est quàm adulterium: ne enim homicidium fieret, permisit Moses dari libellum repudij, & ideo ad hoc periculum euitandum, dixit vxori suæ: Dic obsecro quòd soror mea sis, &c.

Vide autem germanæ charitatis indicium in Sara, quæ vt vxor bona, qualis Eccles. 26. describitur, & Ephes. 5. marito obediuit, vt viuere posset. Non sic diadema in capite positum, regem præclarum ornat, atque obe-dientia illa, qua consilio iusti paruit, beatam & illustrem & claram demonstrauit. Quis non obstupesceret hanc parendi facilita-tem? Quis non obstupesceret, si recte recogitet, quòd post tantam continentiam, & in tali ætate ad hoc vt iustum seruet, quantum in sua voluntate pendebat, etiam adul-terio se expofuit, & barbarorum tulit con-gressum?

ʒ[?] Postremò in Ægyptijs, id est, maledicti Chami posteris obseruandum venit, quàm periculosum & scandalis plenum fit intendere oculos ad formam mulierum, Genes.6. Sirac.9. Matth.5. Item morem aulicorum esse fere vbique, colloqui & sermones conferre de rebus vanis & carnalibus.
Et, dignos esse pœna non solùm eos, qui faciunt mala: sed etiam qui assentiuntur ijs, aut operam suâ præbent, qui faciunt, Rom.I.
Et, Deum esse iudicem scortatorum & adulterorum, Heb.13.

page.notes: The page-number and running head are printed in small capitals and spaced type; the running head is transcribed as "CONCIONES". The initial mark before "Postremò" is a printer's paragraph sign that is hard to read; marked [?]. Long s is read as s throughout (e.g. "sis", "sed", "scandalis"), and words such as "fit" are kept as printed. Scan has no marginal notes. Stray marks at the page edges and bottom centre are not printed text and are omitted.
